answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 10925 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible to put a cloth with the verses of Quran written on it on top a Coffin or a Janazah for blessings and then take it off before burial? Question: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible to put a cloth with the verses of Quran written on it on top a Coffin or a Janazah for blessings and then take it off before burial? Answer ID: 10925 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 267/230=D/1430) It is not proved to put such cloth. Also, it amounts to desecration of Quranic verses; therefore it is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
